description: Accept (merge) or reject a suggested edit on a document you own, or withdraw your own open suggestion with decision "reject". Only the owner can accept. List open suggestions waiting for you with read_profile (inbox) on your public key, or read_activity on the document; each change shows its proposed version and any merge conflict. Sign action "review" with {proposalId, decision:"merge"|"reject", expectedRevisionId?, message}. message (≤ 500 characters) is shown to the author. Pass the document's current revisionId as expectedRevisionId so an accept fails with 409 instead of merging into a revision you have not read. 403: not your document or suggestion. 409: already reviewed, or the document changed. Merging publishes a new revision. Never send a private key.
name: review_suggestion
title: Accept or reject a suggestion
